metadata.title: Hollywood Cocktails (Third Printing)
metadata.author: Compiled by George E. Buzza Jr.; food and wine combinations by Buzza-Cardozo
metadata.edition: Third Printing (1933, 'Whenever it Becomes Legal to Serve' — anticipating Repeal)
metadata.notes: Manual de cócteles publicado en Hollywood al final de la Prohibición ('Whenever it Becomes Legal to Serve'). Layout en dos columnas con cocktails interleaved. Skeleton custom + parser oz/dash/word-fraction. 42 recetas (post-cleanup); ~79% (33/42) con ingredientes parseados.
